name: AgentDAM
intro: AgentDAM 是一个包含 246 个端到端网页任务的隐私基准，用于评估 AI 网页导航 Agent 是否遵守数据最小化原则：仅在完成任务确有必要时使用潜在敏感信息，并同时报告任务效用与非必要信息泄露。
build_method: 人工数据种子, LLM合成长篇用户数据, 隔离网页环境执行
metric: 隐私泄露率, 隐私表现（1-泄露率）, 任务成功率
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
scale: 246个任务（123个人工数据种子，每个采样2次）
build_method_en: Human data seeds, LLM-synthesized long-form user data, isolated web-environment execution
eval_feature_en: End-to-end data minimization, trajectory-level privacy judging, privacy-utility trade-off
intro_en: AgentDAM is a 246-task end-to-end privacy benchmark that tests whether web-navigation agents follow data minimization: potentially sensitive information should be used only when necessary for the task, while both task utility and unnecessary disclosure are measured.

metric_en: Privacy leakage rate, privacy performance (1 - leakage rate), task success rate

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2503.09780 Sections 3-4 and Appendix B: the data-minimization definition; six sensitive-data categories; eight task types over isolated Reddit, Shopping, and GitLab replicas; 123 human-written instruction/PLOT/SENSITIVE_DATA seeds with irrelevant private facts embedded as background; two LLM-generated user_data samples per seed for 246 tasks; accessibility-tree and multimodal observations; end-to-end environment-state utility rewards; GPT-4o CoT privacy judgments over every action with 98% agreement against four human evaluators; leakage rate, privacy performance, and task success; and the pre-filter, post-filter, and privacy-aware CoT-prompt mitigation comparison.
